exposure: infrarenal aortic artery balloon occlusion (IAABC) plus hysterectomy
internal iliac artery balloon occlusion (IIABOC) plus hysterectomy
outcome: Estimated blood loss (EBL) during cesarean section
cohort: 63 women with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) who underwent emergency cesarean hysterectomy
finding: Infrarenal aortic artery balloon occlusion (IAABC) plus hysterectomy resulted in better outcomes than hysterectomy alone or IIABOC plus hysterectomy in women with PAS undergoing emergency cesarean hysterectomy.
